title: Imp Jar & Wick Liquor Utopia 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Utopia by Imp Jar and Wick Liquor is where dreamy flavours collide. This e-liquid offers a gentle wave of succulent peach and delicate elderflower, beautifully accentuated by a dash of fresh lemonade. The result is a vaping experience that's both refreshing and soothing, much like a leisurely stroll through a sunlit English garden. The subtle interplay between the soft peach, fragrant elderflower, and vibrant lemonade makes Utopia a refined choice for those who appreciate a vape that's as sophisticated as it is delightful. This delicious e-liquid is just one of several in an exciting collaboration between Imp Jar and e-liquid legends, Wick Liquor, creators of some of the most unique flavours in vaping. This thrilling partnership means that you can enjoy some of Wick Liquors most iconic creations, with Imp Jar’s 50/50 formulation for use in a wide variety of pod kits and starter kits. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer a more versatile ratio of 50PG/50PG than traditional shortfills, which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances. With Imp Jar shortfills, you’re no longer limited to sub-ohm vaping kits, and can enjoy the superb value of shortfills in a huge variety of MTL vape kits. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one 10ml nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills offer even more longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours and are a more economical and convenient option over 10ml bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid. Imp Jar’s original collection of e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights to frosty menthols, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
